newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PIC details prices for Malbak shares.
newsitem.headline: PIC details prices for Malbak shares.

text.p: South Africa's Public Investment Commissioners (PIC) on Tuesday detailed the prices it is offering for shares undbundled from Malbak Ltd's distribution of its listed companies to shareholders.
PIC is making the offer to gain footholds in South African blue chip companies and prevent a flood of the shares into the market which may depress share prices.

PIC said it will pay 27.65 rand a share for Ellerine Holdings Ltd shares, 29.40 rand for Foodcorp shares, 460 cents for New Clicks Holdings Ltd shares, 37.55 rand for SA Druggists Ltd shares and 715 cents per Malbak share.
The cash offers are lower than market prices at the close of business on Tuesday, but compare well with the five day weighted averages for the stocks.
The firm said the last two day's prices could reflect some price-ramping in the market ahead of the PIC offer.
The cash offer is also net and shareholders will not be charged brokerage fees -- which could cost up to 1.5 percent of the total, PIC said.
